findings.evidence: User logs in using Firebase Auth via loginWithGoogle and loginWithVerifiedEmail in MainActivity.kt, sending the account identifier to Firebase.
findings.recommendation: Ensure this data collection is declared in the Play Store Data Safety form.

findings.issue_summary: Open Web WebView data collection is exempt
findings.evidence: The application initiates a Stripe checkout session and redirects the user to the Stripe web URL via window.location.href, meaning payment info is entered on the open web.
findings.recommendation: No action required. Open web WebView data collection is exempt from prominent disclosure.
